## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 数据页的「校验规则」「动作」两个面板，以及元数据编辑页（ResourceEditPage），表达式写坏后离开标签页或换选中项，草稿仍然不保存；页面上出现一行提示点名是哪条规则 / 哪个动作 / 哪一项，带「Show me」跳回去修。
- 为什么改：按 #27485 裁决 A（6500685972，「同意」）第 3 条把「拦截跟草稿走」推广到兄弟面；以前一离开标签页或换选中，自动保存就把引擎拒收的表达式写进草稿，直到发布才报错且不点名。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端拦截判定，不动 `useDraftAutoSave` 的计时器与单飞；最坏情况是多拦一次（提示行 + Show me 可解），回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`（`panelCelVerdicts` 一段）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`（`inspectorVerdicts` 与 `selectionSlicePath`）、两个新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.panelHold-27629.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.celHold-27629.test.tsx`，预期 8/8 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27629

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The maintainer's ruling on #27485 (comment 6500685972, letter A) makes a CEL parse-fault hold belong to the draft, not to the open editor. PR #27617 did that for the Data pillar's field inspector; this PR ports the same shape to the sibling surfaces item 3 of that ruling names. One measured repro per surface came first (all failed on `main`, see Tests).

- **Data pillar, Validations and Actions panels.** The panels now also report their verdicts per rule or action name (`onCelVerdictsChange`, pruned to the items in the draft; `onBlockingIssuesChange` is unchanged). `DataPillar` keeps each verdict in `panelCelVerdicts` with the stamp of what it judged (`panelItemCelStamp`: the rule or action itself plus the object's field names, the counterpart of `fieldCelStamp`), retaken while the panel is mounted. With the tab left, a kept verdict holds while the draft still carries that stamp; an edit to the item, its removal or the object's next load ends it. While the panel is mounted its own report is the live verdict and wins. The held line names the item (new clauses `engine.studio.held.celInvalidRule` / `celInvalidAction`), its "Show me" reopens it (the Validations panel gains the `focus` prop the Actions panel already had), and the rail switch's flush-or-ask, the Studio Publish refusal and the held-edit report all read the same `objHeld`, unchanged.
- **Settings panel: left out, does not reproduce.** `ObjectDefaultInspector` mounts no CEL editor, so the panel never reports a verdict (its own header says so). It keeps the tab-stamped count it had.
- **`ResourceEditPage`.** Each selection's last live inspector verdict is kept in `inspectorVerdicts` with the fingerprint of the draft slice it judged: `selectionSlicePath` reads the selection id as a path (a page block's `regions[0].components[0]`), else finds the object whose `id` / `name` / `key`, or map key, is the id; the default inspector and an unlocatable id fall back to the whole document. The fingerprint is `issueSliceFingerprint`, the one the server-refusal hold already uses. A kept verdict holds Save, the autosave and the shortcut while that slice is unchanged; the editor shows a held line (`engine.studio.held.inspectorInvalid`) naming the item, and "Show me" reselects it. Item change and the item's load clear the kept verdicts.
- ⛔ Per ruling item 4: no dialog on close, no silent revert, no second autosave path, and `useDraftAutoSave.ts` is untouched.

## Tests

- New `DataPillar.panelHold-27629.test.tsx` (5 cases): leaving Validations / Actions keeps the hold and the held line names the rule / action; "Show me" reopens it with its text and fixing it releases the hold; removing the rule ends it.
- New `ResourceEditPage.celHold-27629.test.tsx` (3 cases): clearing or changing the selection keeps Save and the autosave held and names the block; "Show me" reselects it and fixing it releases.
- `DataPillar.panelGate.test.tsx`: the case "expires the panel count when the author leaves the Rules tab" pinned the superseded tab stamp; flipped to "keeps the hold when the author leaves the Rules tab, and names the rule", citing the ruling.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Residual 250 ms edge, named again, not closed.** The editors lint 250 ms after the last keystroke, so a `flush` (the Data rail switch) inside that window can still read the previous verdict, and a reopened held item reports nothing for about that long (its kept verdict stands meanwhile, so it stays held). Closing it needs a "lint pending" signal from the editors to the host; no such signal exists on this surface, and adding one reaches into every CEL editor, so it is out of this card's file surface. The timer path stays safe: a rising hold cancels the 1.5 s timer and a falling one re-arms a fresh one.
2. **`ResourceEditPage`'s slice locator is best-effort and fails toward release.** When a selection id is neither a path nor an item identity in the draft, the kept verdict is stamped against the whole document, so any edit ends the hold early (the old behaviour, narrowed). A wrongly located slice can over-hold; the held line's "Show me" reopens the item and its live verdict then wins, so Save is never wedged with nothing on screen.
3. **The inspector channel on `ResourceEditPage` is shared.** It carries CEL faults and the required-field refusal in a gated section (ruling 5831744213); both are now kept with the draft, since the count does not tell them apart. The held line's wording is neutral for that reason.
4. **Stale contract prose outside this card's surface.** `MetadataInspectorProps.onBlockingIssuesChange` in `inspector-registry.ts` still says hosts "must reset their own count when the selection changes"; both hosts now keep it with the draft (the field inspector since #27617). Not edited here (file not in the claim); a doc line for the seat to route.
5. **Commit trailer.** The first commit on this branch (`49b01042`) carries the dispatching seat's session id in its `Claude-Session:` trailer instead of this run's; later commits carry this run's. History is not rewritten (the branch is not `claude/issue-*`, so no force push).

## Verification

Run the two new suites (command in 维护者速读). In a running Console: open Studio, Data, an object, Validations, set a rule's guard to `record.status ==`, switch to Form: the draft stays unsaved and the line "Not saved yet: an expression on the rule “…” has an error to fix" appears with Show me.
